observedAt.description: ISO-8601 date we read the source (system time, not source publication time)

sourceKind.description: official-product-page | official-pdf | retailer-tech-page | community-cad | community-forum | own-measurement | derived-geometrically | vendor-fitment-chart

trackWidthMm.description: Claimed track profile width (system-wide, recorded on straight/full)

pieceTypeSlug.description: LEGACY denormalization: piece type path, set on all claims about PieceTypes (rows predating the 2026-07 car-layer widening always have it). New claims of any subject also set subjectSlug

subjectSlug.description: Denormalized subject path with family prefix, e.g. PieceType/curve/r2-30, CarModel/d132/ferrari-296-gt3, PartType/tire/pgt-20124

slotSpacingMm.description: Claimed slot-to-slot spacing (system-wide, recorded on straight/full)

radiusInnerEdgeMm.description: Claimed inner-edge radius (marketing pages use rounded edge values)

tireInnerDiaMm.description: Claimed tire inner diameter / rim size (cars & tire parts)

position.description: front | rear | both — which tires the claimed values concern (cars & tire parts)
